law: REGISTRATION of E-Q31 — the drift monitor, r26 re-read (ORCH-R26 lane T17-d, the standing registered instrument): the third reading of the E-Q22 stability band. 20 fresh embeds of the sealed corpus through the byte-identical noul question map, jev-latest, compared against the SEALED r24 E-Q22 vectors — and, new this round, against the r25 E-Q25 reading — making the monitor a THREE-POINT TIME SERIES (r24 sealed, r25, r26). The monitor's job is to catch serving drift (model version changes, calibration creep) before it corrupts cross-round comparability: every row receipts model_served.
provenance_of_the_question: The standing instrument registered at the r24 close-out and re-read at r25 (E-Q25 P5: 20/20 within 0.10, max 0.06). E-Q23's drift lane measured jev-preview 1.14.0 vs jev-latest 1.13.0 diverging axis-structured 4.30x — if the serving layer has flipped jev-latest to 1.14.x since r25, THIS monitor is where it shows up first (the model_served field, not the delta, is the primary readout for version flips).

design_frozen.calls: The SAME sealed 20-record corpus, one batched call per record, the byte-identical E-Q22 noul map (qmap sha must match), model jev-latest. 20 calls, no stability repeats (the r24/r25 repeats already fixed the intra-round band at <= 0.03-0.06).
design_frozen.comparison: Per record, per axis: |fresh - sealed_r24| and |fresh - r25|; the r25 vectors re-derived from the sealed E-Q25 rows (the 8 real axes of the 12-question calls). Reported: max/mean delta per comparison, within-0.10 counts, per-axis mean deltas (the axis-structure view), and the model_served receipt per call.
design_frozen.verdict_rule: The band HOLDS iff all 20 records are within 0.10 of the sealed r24 vectors (the E-Q22/E-Q25 clause). A version flip (model_served != the r24-r25 served version) is NOT automatically a breach — it is receipted and the delta table under the flip is the finding.

floors.F1: qmap sha byte-identical to E-Q22's (verified at runtime, hard fail otherwise)
floors.F2: all 20 rows complete (8 answers, p in [0,1], model_served receipted)
floors.F3: the r25 comparison vectors recomputed from the sealed E-Q25 rows, not from memory
floors.F4: deltas computed against the SAME record's sealed vector, axis-aligned

hypotheses.H1_band_holds: all 20 fresh-vs-sealed-r24 deltas within 0.10 (the third consecutive hold)
hypotheses.H2_no_trend: the r26 max delta <= the r25 max delta + 0.02 (no compounding drift across readings)
hypotheses.C27: the drift band holds three rounds running — the 8-axis noul map is a STABLE coordinate contract under a fixed serving version — LIVES iff H1

predictions.P2: model_served unchanged from the r24/r25 serving (no version flip)
predictions.P3: per-axis deltas replicate the E-Q23 structure (P2_localrule/P8_exact the movers, P4_alloc/P5_repair the calm ones)
predictions.P4: the r26-vs-r25 deltas are SMALLER than r26-vs-r24 (readings closer in time agree more — the series behaves like sampling noise around a fixed point, not a walk)

falsifier: ANY of F1-F4 breached; a band claim without the full 20-record delta table; a version flip left unreceipted; the r25 comparison silently skipped.
budget: 20 typesafe calls (~$0.006). Part of the r26 round budget ($0.10 ceiling, carried).
